CONSTRUCTION AGREEMENT EXCERPT
Agreement: AGR-PRJ-504
Project Number: PRJ-504
Project: Willow Arts Center - Stair Landing
Owner: Willow Cultural District
Contractor: Vector Ironworks
Executed: March 18, 2026

ARTICLE 7 — CHANGES IN THE WORK
7.1 A change request must identify the work to be added or altered and the basis for an adjustment to contract price or time, as applicable. Work records and communications shall be maintained by the parties.
7.2 For a non-emergency price adjustment the parties shall execute a written Change Order identifying the scope and amount before the changed work begins. The Change Order shall be signed by the Contractor and Carmen Reyes for Owner. Field supervisors may coordinate sequencing and site access but are not named price-signing representatives.
7.3 If Contractor anticipates added cost, it shall notify Owner in writing before the extra work begins and provide an estimate or pricing basis when reasonably available. A field instruction and a price adjustment are separate matters.
7.4 Any waiver, ratification, emergency exception, or other legal consequence depends on the surrounding circumstances and applicable law; this article does not resolve those matters by itself.

END EXCERPT
